title: Water-pressure reducing valve or regulator.
officialText:
Where water pressure within a building exceeds 85 psi (586 kPa) static, an
approved water-pressure reducing valve conforming to ASSE 1003 with strainer shall be installed to reduce the pressure in the
building water distribution piping to 85 psi (586 kPa) static or less.
Exception: Service lines to sill cocks and outside hydrants, and main supply risers where pressure from the mains is reduced to 85
psi (586 kPa) or less at individual fixtures.
